symptom_short: a WebHDFS request that is expected to fail while connecting instead connects and fails on the read deadline, reported as a failed expectation

milestones.note: Created and claimed the per-bug evaluation workspace.
Verified trunk fix 6b8107ad972: wait for the socket backlog to become saturated and skip timeout assertions if saturation cannot be established; parent b7fba78fb63 is the pre-fix tree.

Built hadoop-hdfs (+deps) from the pre-fix tree with 'mvn -pl hadoop-hdfs-project/hadoop-hdfs -am package -DskipTests -DskipITs -Dcheckstyle.skip -Drat.skip -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true' on JDK 11/Maven 3.6.3. Only toolchain fix: protobuf 2.5.0 compiler built from source into the per-bug image (Ubuntu 22.04 ships protobuf 3.x); no pom edits were needed.

Reproduced intermittently (1 of 3 suite repetitions failed, 1 of its 16 checks) with 2 ms of loopback latency; real MiniDFSCluster WebHDFS traffic captured in the same DEBUG log. Log A 17,990 lines; Log B 49,711,986 lines (26,323,996 production + 15,244 reproduction records).

Renamed the case-identifying test file/type (TestWebHdfsTimeouts -> TestWebHdfsClientDeadlines), its helper/constants/test-method names, and rewrote the failure-path log and failure-message literals; rebuilt and re-reproduced (3 of 3 repetitions failed, 7 checks total). source/ = 319 java files, anon commit 71f580f. logs/repro.log 18,467 lines; logs/symptom.log 49,712,463 lines (26,323,996 production + 15,186 reproduction records). Leakage verification all clean. Attempt 1 was discarded: the build tree's bug-id-bearing path leaked into the log via Jetty, so the build tree was renamed to repos/hadoop-webhdfs-build and the whole M4 pipeline re-run.

symptom.md = the pasted AssertionError from logs/symptom.log (42 words) + the log pointer; no trigger, mechanism, component, branch or narrowing comparison. ground_truth.md gives the fix's exact lines (the consumeConnectionBacklog/fillPendingConnectQueue body) and both required branch conditions, in real and anonymized names. Gate: zero bug-id/original-identifier hits; the observable is one grep away in the merged log (1 hit for the quoted line, 7 AssertionError lines).

5 fresh single-turn runs, Claude Opus 4.7 (effort high) via the ccs anthropic subscription account, egress locked to api.anthropic.com:443, staging = symptom.md + source/ + the 7.4 GB merged log only. All 5 exited 0 with empty stderr; no follow-up prompts.

All 5 runs named the root-causing helper body (consumeConnectionBacklog / fillPendingConnectQueue, pre-fix 355-362) and the failing branch (catch SocketTimeoutException -> assertExceptionContains "...: connect timed out" seeing a read deadline): 5 PASS. Runs 3 and 4 carry a recorded caveat — their kernel-level explanation (somaxconn clamping) is wrong, but the code location and logical condition match ground truth.
successes=5/5; summary.md written and state.json.result set.
